title: Bacterium Limits
description: Add basic limits to Bacterium mod
body:
Sets up survival (ish) restrictions on the blocks that can be created or destroyed by [Bacterium](https://modrinth.com/mod/bacterium)

Unbreakable:
- Ancient Debris
- Netherite Block
- Obsidian
- Respawn Anchor
- Lodestone
- Bedrock
- Barrier
- End Portal
- Etc.

Unplaceable:
- All unbreakable blocks
- Anything that requires Iron or Diamond pick
- TNT
- Piston
- Sponge
